params.body:
## Why

Ilse, 18 September 2026: garage Heuten (user 740) gets a 500 when saving a BMW 1 Series that came in through Hexon; on the photo tab the own photos are not shown, the Stocklist copies are. The production log of that day carries two errors for that vehicle:

- `ErrorException: Undefined array key 1` in `PlatformPhotoService::freeName` (`VehicleForm::save` → `finalizeEdit` → `queuePlatformPhotos`)
- `TypeError: PathPrefixer::prefixPath(): Argument #1 ($path) must be of type string, null given` in `photoResource` (`VehicleApiController::detail`, the answer Hexon reads back after every create/update)

## What broke

Hexon uses the partner API (`VehicleApiService::addPhoto`). It saved the `vehicle_photos` row **before** downloading the photo from the partner's URL (`path` is `NOT NULL DEFAULT ''`, `handled` defaults to 1) and set the path only after a successful upload. A download that failed left a row with an empty path. Such a row:

1. is not shown on the photo tab (it needs a thumbnail path): "own photos not loaded";
2. counted as an own photo without a copy when saving a shared vehicle, so `freeName('')` ran; the S3 disk answers "exists" for its own root and `explode('.', '')[1]` threw. The same split-on-first-dot rule lived in `Photo::getFilename`;
3. had no URL to sign in the partner API: every detail call of the vehicle was a 500.

Besides that, the extension map only knew jpeg/png/gif; Hexon delivers WebP, which produced names like `car_image_3.` (trailing dot, no extension).

## What changed

- `App\Support\PhotoNames::free` is the one rule for a free copy name (pathinfo-based; works for any name: no extension, trailing dot, folders, an earlier `(n)`), replacing the two copies in `PlatformPhotoService` and `Photo` helper.
- `PlatformPhotoService::missing` leaves rows without a file alone.
- `vehicleResource` returns only photos that have a file; `photoResource` gives `null` links instead of throwing.
- `VehicleApiService::addPhoto` downloads and stores the three sizes first and writes the row last; WebP keeps `.webp` (like an upload, R S1-6.23), any unknown format is re-encoded as JPEG.
- New `php artisan stocklist:photos-without-file [--dealer=<id>] [--apply]`: lists the rows already on production, deletes them (hard, R S1-6.26) with `--apply`. To do for Heuten after the deploy, then have Hexon re-send the photos (update the vehicle).
- Rules: R S1-6.35 (new), R P3-2.7 amended; finding `2026-09-18-hexon-wagen-500-bij-opslaan` (opgelost).

Not touched: `_wagen_rij.blade.php` checks `!is_null($_p->path)`; an empty string slips through and yields a signed URL to nothing, which the image's `onerror` removes. No crash, so left as is.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/ImportedPhotosWithoutFileTest.php` (5 tests): the free name for any existing name; saving a shared vehicle with a row without a file queues copies only for the photos that exist (reproduced the exact `Undefined array key 1` on the old code); the partner API answers 200 without that row and writes the `api_log` entry; the import writes the row after the files with `.webp`; a failed download leaves no row. Related suites green (PlatformPhotosOnShare, PlatformCopyDelete, PartnerApi, HexonImport, PublicVehicleApi, ProcessImageKeepsPhoto, rules and view guards: 99 tests). `php bin/rules-sources`: Geen problemen.
params.title: Imported photos: a row without a file no longer breaks saving or the partner API
